title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E12 — The Christmas Show
Mark's job as Santa at the mall and his Christmas plans at home both fail miserably, but the Christmas spirit triumphs.Christmas episode.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E13 — Coach
Mark becomes the new head coach of the undefeated basketball team after Coach Corley quits. He starts to think that he doesn't have what it takes to be a winning coach when the team loses their very first game under his coaching.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E14 — One is the Loneliest Number
After Mark and Denise's break-up, Mark discovers that he really does love her and jumps through hoops to get her back. Nicole and Tyler work together selling candy bars in an effort to win the prize for the most sold, a CD player.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E15 — True Lies
In order to be with his girlfriend, Mark lies to Nicole. Mark allows Nicole to punish him after she realizes that he lied. But soon he is tempted to lie to her again.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E11 — Everybody Hates New Year's Eve
Chris is determined to spend New Year's Eve in Times Square, but Rochelle says Chris can only go if he finds a responsible adult to accompany him. The only problem is that the only people Chris can find to be his chaperone are two ex-convicts.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E12 — Everybody Hates Varsity Jackets
Chris and Greg decide to join the wrestling team to land a varsity jacket to impress the ladies.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E13 — Everybody Hates Fake IDs
Chris and Greg realize they'd better find fake IDs or they won't be able to go to the '18 and over' Fat Boys concert. Rochelle plans a surprise party for Julius.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E14 — Everybody Hates PSATs
Knowing that he needs to score well to help him get into college, Chris decides to cram for his PSAT test. When Rochelle makes the family attend a social event, Chris is left with no time to study and resorts to buying the PSAT answer key.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E15 — Everybody Hates Boxing
Coach Thurman witnesses Chris being bullied by Caruso and suggests Chris learn to box to defend himself.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E16 — Everybody Hates Lasagna
Chris reluctantly agrees to hold onto a stash of marijuana for a criminal on the run, but he finds it difficult to find an appropriate hiding place that won't get him in trouble.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E17 — Everybody Hates Bomb Threats
As punishment for Chris' disruption of history class, Chris and his classmates are given the assignment of memorizing a famous speech from World War II and reciting it in front of the class.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E18 — Everybody Hates The Car
After Chris gets his driver's license, Rochelle and Julius give him permission to buy a car, but when the car is stolen and vandalized Chris realizes owning a car is a huge responsibility.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E3 — The Big Frozen Assets Episode
Mona's birthday goes sour when she gets an unwelcome present from her mother. While Dee Dee continues to struggle with her life direction, she is presented with a new career option.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E4 — The Big Training Day Episode
When Mona and Spencer decide to try on line dating, they enlist each other's help in writing their personal profiles. Dee Dee finds her new career as a sports agent to be more challenging than she anticipated.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E5 — The Big Young & The Restless Episode
Mona becomes jealous of her mother when she begins dating a much younger man. Adam begins feeling like a loser when he realizes everyone is accomplishing their goals except him.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E6 — The Big Off Pitch Episode
Dee Dee enlists Mona's help when her agency's star baseball client wants to retire and embark on a music career. Big Dee Dee must break bad news to Phyllis when her cat, Fred, turns up missing.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E7 — The Big State Of The Reunion Episode
Mona must face old demons when she attends her 10 year high school reunion. Kai mounts an investigation after paraphernalia goes missing from the Delicious stock room. Spencer sets a date to meet the girl he's been corresponding with on-line.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E8 — The Big How To Do And Undo It Episode
When Spencer has trouble dumping his new girlfriend, he enlists Dee Dee's help breaking the news. After Phyllis's new boyfriend plans a romantic weekend away, she turns to an unlikely source for help with her sex life.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E9 — The Big Days Of Wine And Neuroses Episode
Dee Dee invites Mona to a 'girl's weekend' at the spa, but Mona soon discovers her sister has an ulterior motive. Spencer's view of the gay world is changed when he spends the weekend with Adam's well connected friends.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E10 — The Big Sexism And The City Episode
When Dee Dee complains her new co-worker, Brett, is questioning her ability to do her job because she is a woman, Charles and Spencer decide they need to intervene on her behalf.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E11 — The Big Sweet Smell Of Success Episode
To boost her spirits from her failing acting career, Big Dee Dee decides to throw a big Legends Ball. Mona begins to worry that her new relationship with Chase is only based on the physical.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E12 — The Big Turning Over A New Leaf Episode
While throwing a baby shower for her ex-boyfriend and his new wife, Dee Dee notices that everyone is paired up except for her, and begins to struggle with her nonexistent personal life.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E13 — The Big Diva Down Episode
Mona & Spencer become at odds over giving their newest act the 'star treatment' during a music video shoot. Meanwhile, Dee Dee is asked to appear on a popular sports program that wants to feature female sports agents.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E14 — The Big My Funny Valentine Episode
Mona becomes worried when her new boyfriend, Chase, seems to have no special plans for their first Valentine's Day together. Dee tries to cheer up Brett when she discovers he broke up with his ex-fiancé a year ago on Valentine’s Day.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:

Fired from her job and dumped by her girlfriend, Malcolm's sister arrives to stay with him and Eddie.

Nicolette enlists Malcolm and Eddie to convince her boyfriend to propose.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:

A friend's upcoming wedding cause Malcolm and Eddie to reexamine their feelings about the women in their own lives.

title: Malcolm & Eddie

A surprise birthday party for Malcolm's dad sets the Shermans and McGees to fighting.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:

Eddie tries to help out the retired race car driver who helped get his first job.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E20 — A Few So-So Men
Malcolm unwittingly hires Eddie's longtime enemy to install a new bar at McGee's.
